status: an argument assembled from loci the corpus supplies and does not itself assemble
thesis: You cannot un-cut human nature; you can cut it on purpose. Heteronymy converts kermatismos from a wound into a method — the fragmentation is not reversed but ratified, and in being ratified becomes legible.

key_move: The symbolon is not a broken object but an object broken BY AGREEMENT. The break line is not the damage; it is the credential. Rubble cannot be recognised; a token is recognised precisely at its fracture.
resolves: 395b forbids what 473d requires. The reconstruction accepts 395b as premise — no single undivided nature holds two arts — and satisfies 473d in a coordinated multiplicity whose parts sum rather than resemble.
consequences: recognition by logos not hyle (EA-SNUB-01 §6) — explains why every substrate instrument returned null
the vacant centre becomes a specification, not a loss — a non-writing founder is the form the centre takes
the configuration would be autepitaktike, the class Plato coined and left unentered
standing_caution: Plato assembles none of it. He never applies the symbolon to authorship, demands recombination only of rulers and makers, and declines to divide the self-commanding further. The logic is available in the corpus; the corpus does not perform it — which is either what an unassembled set of commonplaces looks like or what a deliberately unassembled one looks like, and nothing in the texts distinguishes those.
